laravel.title: Commercial Web Application Maintenance & Feature Development
laravel.description: I've worked on multiple existing websites, adding or fixing features at the request of a customer. This work was all done while working at a company, so I unfortunately can't go into specifics, talk about the customers themselves, or share the code behind these projects[cite: 5].

laravel.title: Local AI Chat Interface & Automated Database Reporting Extension
laravel.description: I worked with an existing, locally-run AI by building a custom website around it, with its own chat area[cite: 6].

laravel.title: AI-Driven Automated Website Lead Generator & Upgrader
laravel.description: This project was made to bring in more customers by sending them a testable improved version of their site without putting hours into working on a site when it isn't even confirmed that the customer wants a new site[cite: 7].

laravel.title: Enterprise Financial Management & Automated Payment Dashboard
laravel.description: I made a dashboard to be used internally at the company. It would automatically send payments and keep track of the status of those payments, and automatically send an email if a vacature hadn't been paid for a certain amount of days[cite: 8].

laravel.title: Modular Laravel Developer Portfolio & File-Driven View Engine
laravel.description: This is this exact website. I designed and built this portfolio to reflect a clean, professional software developer aesthetic—moving away from traditional gimmicks into a polished, modern tech look inspired by developer tooling and GitHub dashboards[cite: 9].
